overview.body: This workshop examines inflation drivers and CPI application.

learning_purpose.body: You will explain drivers and apply CPI reasoning.

knowledge_summary.body: Core inflation concepts include demand-pull and cost-push dynamics.

visual_affordances.subject: Inflation mechanism classification cues
visual_affordances.context: Visual brief: compare demand-pull and cost-push mechanisms by triggering drivers and transmission pathways.
allowed_claims: Different causal mechanisms can produce inflation.
visual_affordances.rationale: Classify scenarios by mechanism before the analysis table.
visual_affordances.pedagogical_added_value: Adds discriminating cause-type cues — not a blank copy of the learner table.
visual_affordances.caption_intent: Cause-type cues only — not the learner table.
visual_affordances.alt_text: Inflation cause-type cues for demand-pull and cost-push; detailed description follows.
visual_affordances.detailed_description: Two parallel cause pathways sit side by side. Demand-pull emphasises excess demand. Cost-push emphasises an upstream cost shock. Labels name triggering drivers only; cells stay empty so learners classify themselves.
